sloka: परस्परं च ये तत्र सैनिकाः सम्बभाषिरे ।किमिदं क्व च वर्तामः किमेतत्स्वप्नदर्शनम् ।। ७.७१.१९ ॥
transliteration: parasparaṁ ca ye tatra sainikāḥ sambabhāṣire ।kimidaṁ kva ca vartāmaḥ kimetatsvapnadarśanam ।। 7.71.19 ॥

translations.english: And the soldiers present there spoke to each other, wondering, "What is this? Where are we? Is this a dream vision?"
